description: This is a Python source file for a report module in the ERPNext system, specifically generating GSTR-1 GST reports for Indian GST compliance. It defines a class for report generation, multiple functions for data processing, and report export functionalities.

classes.name: Gstr1Report
classes.description: A class responsible for generating GSTR-1 GST report data, including fetching invoice data, calculating tax details, and preparing report columns and rows.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point to generate the report, initializes Gstr1Report and runs it.

methods.name: get_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON structure for GST filing based on report data and filters.

methods.name: download_json_file
methods.description: Handles the download of the report data as a JSON file.
